nodes.label: Clickable Wizard Navigation
nodes.rationale: Users may jump to any already reached step, while unreached steps remain disabled.

nodes.label: maxStep Reachability State
nodes.rationale: A monotonic furthest-reached step preserves access when navigating backward.

nodes.label: Persisted Wizard Reachability
nodes.rationale: Persisting maxStep separately from the current step prevents reloads from relocking reached steps.

nodes.label: First-Advance Gate Semantics
nodes.rationale: Card and cash gap gates apply only to the first footer-based forward advance; a passed gate does not block later revisits.

nodes.label: Pharmacy Food Default Override
nodes.rationale: A deterministic retail-chain override is as informative as the LLM because both see only the store name, but the override is predictable.

nodes.label: Retail Pharmacy Chain Matcher
nodes.rationale: Full chain tokens avoid matching health-fund pharmacies while substring matching tolerates branch suffixes.

nodes.label: Health-Fund Pharmacy Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Health-fund pharmacies and clinics retain medical classification; only named retail drugstore chains receive the food default.

nodes.label: Mobile PWA Share Target
nodes.rationale: A single PWA share target sends shared images and PDFs into the existing upload flow without a native TWA or PWA framework.

nodes.label: Share-Only Service Worker
nodes.rationale: The worker intercepts only POST /share-target so it cannot alter normal navigation or introduce offline caching behavior.

nodes.label: useSharedFiles Pickup Hook
nodes.rationale: A callback with a latest-function ref performs one-shot pickup without a consumer effect that violates the hooks lint rule.

nodes.label: Progressive Share Enhancement
nodes.rationale: If service workers, Cache Storage, installation, or HTTPS are unavailable, ordinary upload remains unaffected.

nodes.label: Fit-to-Page PDF Export
nodes.rationale: User comparison proved scale=1 caused page fragmentation and scale=4 matched Sheets fit-to-page output.

nodes.label: RTL Signature Positioning
nodes.rationale: Mirroring follows the sheet rightToLeft flag but remains an E2E calibration question because earlier output suggested Sheets may not mirror the export.

nodes.label: Staged PDF Progress Feedback
nodes.rationale: Stage labels and counters make a sequential two-to-four-minute export transparent without parallelizing it.

nodes.label: Report Progress Anonymity
nodes.rationale: Progress includes stage and counters only, never personal values or filenames.

nodes.label: Manual No-Receipt Marker
nodes.rationale: A deliberate per-line marker distinguishes expenses that legitimately have no receipt from receipts still awaiting collection; auto-detection is deferred.

nodes.label: Live Drive Receipt Link
nodes.rationale: Prefer Sheets smart chips when writable; otherwise use a USER_ENTERED HYPERLINK formula to preserve a live previewable link.

nodes.label: Government Report Invariance
nodes.rationale: The marker documents receipt status but never changes whether an expense contributes to government-report sums.

nodes.label: Family Account Model B
nodes.rationale: Members operate with their own OAuth tokens against automatically shared owner assets; this avoids storing long-lived owner credentials but accepts Drive-level access outside the app.

nodes.label: Signed Active-Account Cookie
nodes.rationale: An HMAC-signed httpOnly cookie remembers the selected account and caches verified membership for about ten minutes to avoid a Sheets read on every request.

nodes.label: Server-Side Permission Matrix
nodes.rationale: API checks are the enforcement boundary; hidden or disabled UI is convenience only.

nodes.label: Family Access Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Cookie claims are signed and TTL-bound, emails are normalized, removal revokes Drive access, and no personal details enter logs or report progress.

nodes.label: ManageFamily Capability
nodes.rationale: An explicit capability removes the Full role's blanket authorization while preserving exhaustive role checks.

nodes.label: Strict Registry Read-Modify-Write
nodes.rationale: A transient settings read failure must not be interpreted as empty settings and wipe the membership registry.

nodes.label: Idempotent Drive Permission Sync
nodes.rationale: Listing before create, update, or delete makes repeated POST and DELETE safe and turns re-adding a member into repair for partial sharing failures.

nodes.label: Stored Upload Folder ID Resolution
nodes.source_location: Upload folder on a shared account
nodes.rationale: A stored owner folder ID avoids nondeterministic name search across identically named personal and shared folders; missing IDs skip image upload rather than write into the wrong Drive.

nodes.label: Active Shared-Account Indicator
nodes.rationale: A visible owner-email and role badge closes the data-safety gap caused by personal and shared accounts otherwise looking identical.

nodes.label: Shared Report Path Deferred
nodes.rationale: Report folders and templates remain on the member's Drive until a dedicated plan can replace fragile name-based resolution and track stale grants.

nodes.label: Settings Last-Write-Wins Race
nodes.rationale: Concurrent settings and family writes can overwrite the shared key-value range; the low-probability race is accepted because Sheets lacks locking.

nodes.label: Inline Family Role Editing
nodes.rationale: An explicit inline edit flow avoids disguising role changes as re-adding a member through the add form.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Member List
nodes.rationale: The UI does not optimistically mutate members; successful API responses replace local state, while failed updates preserve the draft.
